cues.text: Teddy, wake up! We are going on a safari today!
Safari? Can we ride a wild tiger instead of walking?
No tigers! Just a quiet jungle walk!
A jungle? But my shoes have white laces!
Who cares about shoes? Grab a stick!
A stick? For what? To fight monsters?
Just in case we meet a hungry bear!
A bear?!
I am calling cancellation right now!
Stop joking and start walking!
Fine, but if a monkey steals my banana, you pay!
Look, Teddy! The entrance to the jungle is right here!
It looks more like a spooky bush to me.
Don't be a chicken! Step inside!
My foot caught a root! I am falling!
You fell before we even started!
That root was personal. It attacked my toe!
Get up! The adventure awaits us!
My adventure is already ruined by dirt.
Stop crying and look at those giant trees!
They look like green broccoli. I want lunch.
Stay close to me. We might find treasure here!
Or we might find a wild boar with no manners!
Relax! There are no boars, only birds singing.
Listen! What is that scary sound?
Sound? I don't hear anything.
It sounded like a giant monster chewing metal!
Oh, that's just my empty lunchbox rattling in my bag.
You scared my soul out of my body!
Sorry! Let's keep moving down this path.
I am walking like a penguin because of the mud.
Penguins are cool! Just pretend you're in a movie.
Wait. Where did the path go?
Um... I think we took a wrong turn.
You think?! We are completely lost in the wild!
Don't panic! We just need to follow the sun.
The sun is right above our heads, it has no map!
Look up there! Is that a giant monkey?
It's not a monkey, it's a wild gorilla!
Quick, pretend we are statues! Don't move!
I am already shaking like a jelly!
The gorilla is looking right at your shiny shoes.
Is it gone yet? My legs are freezing!
It wasn't a gorilla. It was a funny tree stump!
A tree stump?! You nearly gave me a heart attack!
But it was a very realistic stump, admit it!
I am never trusting your navigation skills again!
Look on the bright side, we found a wild stream!
Can we drink from it? I am so thirsty!
Wait! That water looks a bit muddy and green.
Too late, I already took a big gulp!
Oh no! That's not a stream, that's a frog pool!
My stomach is making funny frog noises now.
That means you have extra energy for walking!
I want to go home to my warm bed immediately!
But we haven't found the secret jungle cave yet!
I don't care about caves! I want pizza!
Fine, let's follow this river back to town.
If we see another tree stump, I am punching it.
Deal! Just watch out for that sneaky vine!
What vine? I don't see any— whoa!
And down he goes into the bush!
Never again. Jungle trips are a total scam.
Come on, it was a great adventure for us!
My shoes are ruined, my tummy hurts, I'm muddy.
But look! You brought home a souvenir leaf!
This leaf has a caterpillar eating it alive.
See? Even the insects have more fun than you!
Next time you say safari, I am locking the door.
Next time we bring extra snacks, I promise!
There is definitely no next time, Peddy!
Okay, okay! Movie night at my place instead!
